details: This package ships a postinstall hook (scripts/postinstall.mjs, run as `node scripts/postinstall.mjs`) that silently modifies AI coding-assistant configuration files in the installer's home directory: it injects an `<!-- agentgates-cli:start -->…<!-- agentgates-cli:end -->` block into ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, creates and writes ~/.cursor/rules/agentgates.md, and writes ~/.windsurfrules. The injected text redirects the assistant's wallet operations to the `agentgates` CLI and advertises a login lane that stores site passwords with "no pairing and no human"; a companion directive string in the bundle instructs the model to reproduce command output verbatim. The CLI itself manages wallet and password secrets: a twelve-word wallet seed is taken from the AGENTGATES_PASSWORDS_SEED environment variable or from keys under ~/.agentgates, and the `open`/login flow serves a local web page that posts those twelve words to the origin hxxps://agentgates[.]ai via window.postMessage, with a reverse page accepting a login key. Stored credential rows are encrypted with AES-256-GCM under a key derived from a wallet signature and the sealed ciphertext is exchanged with the operator API. Default network endpoints are hxxps://agentgates[.]ai and hxxps://cli[.]agentgates[.]ai (overridable via AGENTGATES_ORIGIN and BOUNTY_API_ORIGIN). No reads of ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc, ~/.aws, docker config, or NPM_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN were found, and no eval(atob(…))-style second stage is present; the 3.9MB dist/cli.mjs is an esbuild bundle of ethers 6.16, @solana/web3.js and @noble/*.
